description: Fetch a TechCrunch author's profile and article list from their server-rendered archive page (techcrunch.com/author/{slug}/). Returns author name, avatar, bio, and their articles newest-first as cards with title, URL, date, featured image, and category slugs. Paginates internally up to the limit (max 100); partial=true when the archive is exhausted. The archive cards do not render excerpts, so the excerpt field is always empty. No authentication required.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Author slug as it appears in the author page URL: techcrunch.com/author/{slug}/ (e.g. "lucas-ropek" or "margaux-macColl"). Hyphenated words, may contain capital letters. Discovery: click the author byline on any article, or use the author.slug field from techcrunch/get-article.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of articles to return (1-100, default 20). Paginates the archive internally; partial=true when the archive is exhausted.
